notes.title: Update: a few fixes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We've pushed a little update fixing a few bugs: 

[list]
[*]The game was displaying debug options from the pause menu while in a fight, this has been removed.

[*]Game now saves progress and decks inside the following folder:
[i]%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\FishingCactus\UrbanceCardGame[/i].

[/list]
Hope you're having fun on Urbance! :)
